name: Miss U More
description:
Miss U More is a deliberately tiny one-button messaging app. You name exactly one other person; when they name you back, you're Connected. This connector gives you the whole app: check the scoreboar
d, tap Miss U, or update your display name. It cannot change who you miss, manage emails, or access your avatar. It only sends a notification to the one person you're Connected to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Miss U More to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Miss U More to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://missu.fyi/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Miss U More MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miss U More provides these MCP tools: missu, set_name, and status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Miss U More?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Miss U More in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Miss U More MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Miss U More requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Miss U More is developed by Glimpsed Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
